free.question: Is Tryit free?
free.answer: Yes: pick any 3 games free every day, with no account needed. Plus unlocks all 19 games and the full archive.

account.question: Do I need an account to play?
account.answer: No. You can finish your 3 free puzzles as a guest. An account keeps your streak, results and stats across devices.

schedule.question: When do new puzzles appear?
schedule.answer: Every day at 16:00 UTC. Take on the same puzzles as your friends and compare results.

streak.question: How do streaks work?
streak.answer: Finish any of the 19 games in daily mode before the next daily reset to keep your streak going. Wins and losses both count; archive and practice play do not.

share.question: Can I share my result without spoiling it?
share.answer: Yes. The result card shows your result (time, tries or solving pattern), the puzzle and the day — never the solution. Anyone who opens it plays the same day's puzzle.

catalog.question: Which puzzles are included?
catalog.answer: Nineteen daily puzzles across words, logic, numbers, spatial play and light entertainment, all following the same daily ritual.
